steps.content: [Monologue Filter Begins]

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: From a very young age, I traveled with my father across the farlands, far beyond the borders of DisCity.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: I saw all kinds of people, cultures, and rhythms of life, unlike anything at home. Like stars of every color scattered across the earth, each shining with its own light.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Some fought simply to survive. Some worked to preserve what they had. Some longed for change, while others prayed only for peace.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Even amid catastrophes and recurring sorrow, they have never stopped speaking—in a thousand tongues, from a thousand soils—each carrying their own weight, each holding their own fragile, stubborn dream.
[Scene Change]
Saina steps onto the wreckage of the podium and seizes the fallen loudspeaker. Her voice, hoarse but firm, cuts through the chaos to fill every hall of Fraser Gold Palace.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: I know it all! You conspired with Jabara and his kind to bleed the farlands dry. Fraser sells Hypercubes to us at several times DisCity's price. Of course we can't afford them!

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: You hoard supplies, gouge prices, and make DisCity and the farlands pay in blood!

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: It's not just Hypercubes. Fraser's ledgers show steel, grain, and even... people! You're all ******* monsters!

The ledger lands with a soft thud at an elderly representative's feet. After a moment of hesitation, he picks it up. A few quick page turns drain the color from his face. Alarmed glances shoot across the delegation seats, and a ripple of suppressed murmurs begins to build.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: This ledger only goes back five years. You bastards must have older ones... Talk! When did it start?!

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: Argh! W-we were just trying to survive! Isn't everyone the same...?

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: Cut all that crap!

The murmurs swell into an angry roar in an instant. Saina seizes Jabara by the collar and hurls his obese frame aside like a trash bag. A flash of her blade slashes open his coat, spilling hidden luxury silk and gem-studded rings—their obscene opulence glinting under the light.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: Look at the starving, freezing people of the farlands. Look them in the eye! Do you dare say you're the same as them?!
[Intercut Monologue Filter]

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Differences inevitably lead to discord. In a world of widespread catastrophes and scarce resources, everyone must fight fiercely for what they desire. Friction and conflict... they're unavoidable.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Yet I have always been good at coordination. I prefer elegant, gentle methods—finding common ground among divergent wants, weaving mutual happiness from seemingly opposing needs.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Wherever I go, I plant seeds of peace. I... love peace of that kind. Graceful. Deliberate.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: But alas, the moment the gardener turns her back, those carefully tended shoots are trampled by careless feet, uprooted entirely by short-sighted hands...
[Scene Change]
The hall ignites. Farland delegates surge to their feet, their eyes burning with the fire of betrayal as a wave of collective fury crashes through the assembly.

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: You are... Saina? Heh, such insolence. Have you forgotten who gave you Aurum Secretum? Who granted you power and dignity? And who made you suffer in the first place?

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: We gave you the chance for vengeance against DisCity, and now you turn on us like their loyal hound?
He snarls, thrusting a finger toward Margaret in a desperate bid to redirect Saina's fury. But Saina doesn't so much as glance aside. Her fists clench until her nails bite deep into her own palms.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: I... still hate DisCity. Even now. But...

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: That doesn't make you the righteous ones!
Saina clenches her teeth and takes a threatening step forward.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: You've been lying to us... using our pain, our rage. You and the Society are no different.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: My brothers and sisters who died for the Ash Campaign... They believed your lies until their last breath! And you still expect us to bleed for you?!

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: Listen! It's not DisCity I hate. I hate every monster who preys on the farlands. And that includes you!!

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: It's time to answer for what you've done. Get down here, and bring those Society snakes with you!
"Get down here!"
A voice in the crowd takes up the cry, and the farland delegation ignites. They surge forward, a wave of furious shouts, and the situation fractures in seconds.

The venue guards finally snap into action, weapons drawn against the civilians protesting in fury. It's the wrong move. Enraged, the farlanders seize anything at hand—chairs, candelabras, daggers drawn from hidden sheaths—and the hall erupts into open combat.
Meanwhile, from her place in the "defendant's seat," Margaret watches the chaos unfold below—a farce of history, replaying exactly as she has seen it before.
[Flashback Filter]

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: They fan hatred and stoke the flames of war... Those in power never feel the sting when others bleed. They care nothing for justice or vengeance, only how conflict can be turned into more wealth, more power.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Hmph. Even in their greed, these shortsighted fools never learn more elegant, harmonious methods. They always return to the crudest means, spending the lives of others like cheap currency. Myopic. Insatiable. And in the end, even their own gains turn to dust.
[Cutaway]

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: DisCity hoarded their Hypercubes while calamity destroyed our home. Fraser talks about humanism, but all they've done is turn us into lab rats for Aurum Secretum, giving us nothing but ruin.

steps.speaker: Arienna
steps.content: ...So naive, Sibilla. Did you really think they'd help? DisCity doesn't care. They don't understand our suffering—they can't even imagine it.

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: You get to live in luxury by sucking us dry, and you have the nerve to talk to me about what's right?!
[Return to Monologue]

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: They never learn respect. They never learn reflection. History simply repeats... over and over again, unchanged.
[Black Screen Transition to N.F. 106]

N.F. 106
DisCity Embassy in Fraser

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: That's impossible! I designed this Great Expo myself. I've spoken with every Alliance leader. I know their concerns! Dravyn has stepped down, and the farlands need time to heal. We drafted a five-year framework for mutual benefit. Breaking it now serves no one's interests! And besides—

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: This is a Black Ring we're talking about! Who would benefit from worsening catastrophes? The farlands haven't even mastered large-scale Mania defense! I was here on the ground. There was no celebration, only panic! The people here didn't even understand what's happening!

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: The Observatory tragedy was a setup. Someone is deliberately sabotaging this! Don't let anger blind you. Send Blackett. She can uncover the truth. Don't rush into war. Don't—
A Black Ring appeared at the Navigator Observatory. The Great Expo was terminated. The Outland War reignited, lasting one year, with affected regions...

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: ...Even my most principled friend had to suffer for your folly...

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: It's always the same. Always... No matter how strong the foundation I lay, once it's in your hands, you tear it down.
[End of Flashback] [Return to Present]

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: Aaaahhh—! Heeelp!!
CLANG!

A sharp metallic clang rings out as Saina's blade intercepts a guard's strike meant for a civilian. But there are too many targets, too few of her. Dozens of meters away, another scream pierces the air.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: You dare attack civilians...

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: I'll kill you!!
The Aurum Secretum howls through her veins as blood spills from her wounds. Every cut feels like a fresh brand of fire, but she can't reach them all. She is still not fast enough.
All the combat skills she has honed to kill Disians now fail her. They cannot outrun the slaughter carried out by her own people, cannot protect the civilians who had always stood behind her.
Just then—
BWAK!
A sniper shot cracks from behind. The attacking Aurum Secretum guard's head erupts, spraying contaminated matter across the ground. The body jerks once, twice, then slumps into the mud.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: That's—?!
Saina spins toward the source of the shot. High above, framed against a pillar, Helga's silhouette remains steady in her sniper's perch. She raises a hand in a clear, distant signal of support.
Then, with calm precision, she shifts her aim, the rifle's scope settling on the woman seated center stage.

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: Is this what you wanted, Margaret Kervoz? What have you done? What in the hells are you playing at?!
The woman sits, perfectly composed. Her eyes lift, meeting Helga's gaze unflinchingly through the scope. Amidst the surrounding chaos, only her smile remains enigmatic and undisturbed.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Are you curious what I'm thinking, Ms. Helga?

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: What I'm thinking of, naturally, is nothing but peace.
[Flashback]

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Jabara is a pure pragmatist, sworn to profit, not to any flag. All it took was a few whispers through Fraser's business circles, rumors that DisCity was gaining ground while Fraser retreated... and he eagerly came to me, looking for an exit.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Rael, by contrast, sees only in absolutes—hot-blooded, impulsive. He dismisses anything from DisCity as a lie, and has sworn to expose every conspiracy... Heh, how adorable. With just a little guidance, I can shape that righteous suspicion into something useful. His words carry far more weight with the masses than mine ever could.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: As for the bewildered Yokna and her people... they'll believe anything. Deep down, everyone craves a clear answer, someone to point the way, to tell them which path is true.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: And all of this was made possible by my lovely little canary, set free...

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: She never needed to win their favor or extract promises. Hypatia simply has to be herself, and everyone who speaks with her lays their hearts bare. That is something I could never do.
[Flashback]

steps.speaker: Rael
steps.content: Disians are cunning as foxes! Of course it's possible!

steps.speaker: Yokna
steps.content: The farlands lack everything: technology, resources, skilled hands...

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: I would only ask that, when your journey concludes, you must convey my humble regards to Mr. Adelaide.

steps.speaker: Surveillance Dove
steps.content: ...Coo.
[Scene Change]

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Only someone as sincere, as utterly devoted as you, could hold such power. Thank you for opening their hearts to me... for letting me see what everyone truly desires.
And Helga, who sees Fraser's plot clearly but remains powerless to stop it; even Saina and her fellow Aurum Secretum Warriors...
Through the bird communicator accompanying Hypatia, she has watched from Fraser as if she were there, understanding every move in the farlands as it unfolds.
[Flashback Filter]

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Tell me... what should I do...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I know you're there. Please, don't keep hiding from me, Ms. Margaret, Mr. Rust... I'd be content just walking behind you. Please... Even if all I can see is your back, even if I'm only following your shadow...
[End of Flashback]
As the chaos continues, teetering on the edge of escalation, Margaret sits perfectly still. She is waiting, for that moment.
Now, let Fraser's mask fall completely.
Let the people of the Farland Alliance see the hypocrisy of their so-called shield. Let them realize these high-and-mighty nobles have never walked the same road.
Only when illusions shatter can reality be seen. Only when they face the harsh truth and lay down their hatred, will they see the true path, and the hand that's been waiting to guide them.
I will extend that hand... The moment is almost here...

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: Madness... This is absolute madness! Guards! The Society! Where are those Underground Sophos?! Do something!

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: Apprehend these riotous lunatics!
Amid the screams, shadowy Underground Puppets emerge from below—weapons originally meant for Margaret now turning on the farland crowd. They advance, and the massacre begins.
...The perfect moment hasn't come, but she can no longer watch.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: This has gone far enough... You still haven't learned when to stop.
Margaret rises and walks toward the crowd. The guards meant to watch her are now lost in the chaos; no one remains to stop her.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: When the weak cannot decide their own fate, and chaos only breeds more tragedy... someone must step forward to build bridges. To find a way through the deadlock.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: To find that solution, I am willing to use any means... and bear every consequence.
Whether exploiting human weakness or wielding Mania's power... a dove of peace does not obsess over keeping its feathers white. It only cares that peace will prevail at journey's end.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Listen to what everyone truly desires, then do everything in my power to fulfill it. When conflicts arise, I find ways to harmonize opposing needs.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: A world where every wish and want can be reasonably met—isn't that the very meaning of "peace"?

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: And that is precisely why I find your actions so intolerable. You use the crudest, most repulsive methods, not only destroying the peace I have built, but crushing the last hope of those who came to you for aid.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Heh, you noblemen of Fraser... you hold yourselves above, yet wallow in incomprehensible stupidity.
[Big CG - Animated]

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: If you do not understand what peace is...

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Then I will be the one to teach you.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: It is necessary compromise, anchored by conviction. It is occasional passion, tempered by reason. It is honesty preserved, cooperation honored, conscience upheld. It is extending a hand despite opposition, choosing dialogue even when the path is difficult.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: I'm sorry. Is the concept too difficult to grasp?

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Do not worry. Simply heed my guidance, and I will lead you toward true harmony and unity.
S-Class Mania erupts from her, instantly silencing the chaotic hall. Above, countless white doves materialize, scattering across Fraser City like a promise—each one a vessel of her will.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Bid farewell to your Underground friends. A peaceful world has no place for their interference.
